theorems.name: Submission.adr_rescaled_content_lower_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ℓ : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ) (U : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)), 0 < ℓ → 0 < ρ → (∀ C : ℕ → Set (Euclid P), A ∩ ball x ρ ⊆ ⋃ j, C j → ENNReal.ofReal ρ ^ ℓ ≤ 2 * ∑' j, Metric.ediam (C j) ^ ℓ) → (∀ z : Euclid P, x + (2 * ρ) • z ∈ A → ‖z‖ < 1 / 2 → z ∈ ⋃ j, U j) → (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ (-ℓ) / 8 ≤ ∑' j, Metric.ediam (U j) ^ ℓ
